title: From Lumberjacks to Jacked Snowmen, Old Spice Delivers 24/7 Holiday Freshness Across Six Limited Edition Holiday Scents
summary: From Lumberjacks to Jacked Snowmen, Old Spice Delivers 24/7 Holiday Freshness Across Six Limited Edition Holiday Scents
body_markdown:
CINCINNATI--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Smellebrate the holidays with the Old Spice Holidudes Collection, a limited seasonal lineup of men’s deodorant, body wash, and 2-in-1 shampoo scents that brings the bold and unexpected spirit of winter to your grooming routine. Forget basic gingerbread and standard evergreen - Old Spice is *sleighing* the season with six high-performance long-lasting scents crafted to keep guys smelling legendary all season long. Designed to tackle sweater-weather sweat and odor, and eliminate the need for armpit sniff-checks, this year’s roster serves up a personality-driven lineup built for every winter mood.


**Meet the Holidudes:**


- **Lumbersnack** Scent of Fresh Pine | Available in Deodorant, Body Wash, and 2-n-1 Shampoo – Meet the lumberjack nutcracker of the Holidudes lineup, bringing fresh-pine energy and a crisp evergreen escape worthy of a winter woods adventure.
- **Snickerdudel** Scent of Sugar Cookie | Available in Antiperspirant and Body Wash – A gingerbread-inspired cookie character serving fresh-from-the-oven holiday energy, with a sweet Sugar Cookie scent made for anyone ready to smell like the most legendary snack at the party.
- **Jacked Frost** Scent of Frosted Mint | Available in Antiperspirant and Body Wash –This ripped snowman is cool, crisp and built for peak holiday freshness, bringing frosted-mint energy straight from the tundra to your routine.
- ***NEW* Brutecake** Scent of Iced Cranberry | Available in Deodorant and Body Wash –A snowboarding bear brings a frosty spin to cranberry with a crisp Iced Cranberry scent inspired by tart cranberry, frosted berries and icy winter air. Think holiday fruitcake reimagined the Old Spice way: sweet, fresh and unexpectedly icy.
- ***TARGET EXCLUSIVE*** **Tonicfella** Scent of Glacial Spritz | Available in Deodorant and Body Wash – This Holidude shakes up the ultimate holiday refresher, bringing crisp, icy Glacial Spritz energy to the seasonal lineup.
- ***TARGET EXCLUSIVE* Chaiguy** Scent of Spiced Latte | Available in Antiperspirant and Body Wash – Meet the holiday barista serving up a warm, cozy Scent of Spiced Latte for a deliciously festive contrast to the collection's frosty favorites.


The collection is available across a variety of deodorants, antiperspirants, body washes and 2-in-1 shampoos, giving fans multiple ways to bring holiday freshness to their daily routines. From crisp and outdoorsy to cool, sweet and frosty, the Holidudes make it easy to *Fresh the Halls* with a seasonal scent for every kind of winter mood.


“The holidays have a character all their own, and Old Spice’s Holidudes collection celebrates the personalities that make the season memorable,” said Scott Popham, Senior Director, Communications, Personal Care Portfolio, Procter & Gamble. “Inspired by every type of guy from the cozy holiday barista to the winter gym stud, these six limited-edition scents put a playful twist on seasonal traditions while delivering the legendary odor protection guys expect from Old Spice. It’s a fresh take on stocking stuffers for men that helps guys smell ridiculously good all season long.”


The Old Spice Holidudes collection will be available for a limited time at select retailers nationwide in singles, holiday gift sets, and seasonal displays while supplies last.


**About Old Spice**


Old Spice, the most awarded men’s deodorant brand*, has been an iconic name in grooming for more than 80 years and is the No. 1 selling antiperspirant and deodorant brand for men in the United States. As a category leader, Old Spice offers pro-level performance across the men’s grooming ecosystem that includes antiperspirants, deodorants, body washes, body sprays, shampoos and hair stylers. Old Spice is the authority on the complete men’s grooming regimen. Old Spice products have received recognition from leading publications, including[CEW’s 2026 Beauty Awards](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcew.org%2F2026-beauty-awards-gallery%2F&esheet=54642446&newsitemid=20261117473767&lan=en-US&anchor=CEW%26%238217%3Bs+2026+Beauty+Awards&index=1&md5=3632c2f225b9893e96b84a1dde200fd9) for Old Spice’s Spice Alchemist Body Wash,[Men’s Health’s 2026 Smell Fresh Awards](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.menshealth.com%2Fgrooming%2Fa73284340%2Fmens-health-2026-smell-fresh-awards%2F&esheet=54642446&newsitemid=20261117473767&lan=en-US&anchor=Men%26%238217%3Bs+Health%26%238217%3Bs+2026+Smell+Fresh+Awards&index=2&md5=ec91b2584d403565be1593acb4b7d94c) for Old Spice’s Spice Alchemist Deodorant,[Men’s Journal’s 2026 Grooming Awards](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mensjournal.com%2Fstyle%2Fbest-grooming-products&esheet=54642446&newsitemid=20261117473767&lan=en-US&anchor=Men%26%238217%3Bs+Journal%26%238217%3Bs+2026+Grooming+Awards&index=3&md5=a87c2e69c3bc1068088dd91cdcc43412) for Old Spice’s Spice Alchemist Deodorant and Old Spice Total Body Deodorant (Fiji Scent), and[Esquire’s 2025 Grooming Award](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.esquire.com%2Fstyle%2Fgrooming%2Fa65665281%2Fesquire-grooming-awards-2025%2F&esheet=54642446&newsitemid=20261117473767&lan=en-US&anchor=Esquire%26%238217%3Bs+2025+Grooming+Award&index=4&md5=f67cb42f2c9461c3b9a94ff853ea44b9) for Old Spice Total Body Deodorant.
